title: Middle of the Linked List
statement: Return the middle node of the list. When the length is even there are two middles, and you return the SECOND one.
hints: Counting the length then walking half of it is two passes and completely fine.
For one pass, advance a slow pointer one step and a fast pointer two steps.
When fast falls off the end, slow is at the middle. Looping while fast and fast.next are both non-null lands on the second middle for even lengths.
